title.narrative: Building Resilience to Climate Change in Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: The proposed Building Resilience to Climate Change in Papua New Guinea (PNG) (formerly Strategic Program for Climate Resilience Implementation Project for Papua New Guinea (the Project)) aims to make PNG's development investments climate resilient and support the country's transition to climate compatible development, as outlined in its national medium- and long-term development strategies. The Project will facilitate integration of climate resilience into development processes through (i) enhanced access to financial resources dedicated to climate change adaptation; (ii) development and dissemination of knowledge products and adaptation tools; (iii) better understanding of climate change vulnerabilities and adaptation options; (iv) increased adaptive capacity at the sectoral, national, district, and community levels, thereby building climate resilient communities, addressing climate change risks to food security; and (v) development of climate-resilient infrastructure-all prerequisites for effective social development, food security, and poverty reduction.

Grant 0447: 83% of contracts awarded and 68% disbursed as of 03 Jul 2025
Grant 0598: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 03 Jul 2025
Grant 0600: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 03 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Project implementation support consultants are on board. UNDP (Community Facilitation NGO) was recruited in March 2020 but commenced in July 2020 due to COVID19 lock down period. The construction of the pilot climate proof Alotau Provincial Wharf is completed, and procurement of early warning systems and water supply and sanitation facilities are in progress. Manus early warning system and communication network was completed in November 2021 and contractors have progressed in other four provinces in installing the VHF and HV systems.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Oct 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46495/46495-002-apfs-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Jun 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46495/46495-002-esmr-en_11.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Nov 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46495/46495-002-iee-en.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Climate Change and vulnerability assessments have been carried out and the Small Grant Facility that complements the financing of investments identified during the vulnerability mapping and planning process has been established. Remaining activities include (i) mainstreaming of climate change adaptation plans (CCVAP) into 21 local level government (LLG) and Provincial Development Plans along with Emergency Response Strategy (ERS) training for 21 target island community beneficiaries; (ii) the procurement, delivery and installation of water and sanitation facilitates in vulnerable island communities and (iii) complete the procurement and delivery of sub-project proposals under the Small Grant Facility.
The enabling framework for climate resilient infrastructure has been established and the construction of the pilot climate proof Alotau Provincial Wharf is completed with Additional Financing grants fully utilized. Remaining activities include (i) procurement, delivery and installation of early warning systems in AROB and Milne Bay; and (iii) the commissioning and operationalizing of HF/VHF network in 21 Island communities and linked them to provincial relay stations.
As of September 2024. UNDP Subcontractor ECA has completed reports for the resource assessments in all 9 target island sites for Milne Bay, Manus and East New Britain, and submitted them to PMU on 13 September 2024. Results/Analysis from the baseline assessment reports will serve as basis for planning subsequent activities starting next quarter and inform baseline for DMF indicators on fish population and food insecurity level.
Project Audit Financial Statement and Semi-annual Environment Safeguards Monitoring Reports are posted. BRCC Procurement Plan are cleared and uploaded on ADB sites.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/46495-002/main#project-tenders
